title: Exploring Graph Neural Networks for Indian Legal Judgment Prediction

bias_targets.methodology: Redacting gender-specific pronouns (e.g., he, him, his, her, she) from the legal case corpus and replacing them with a [gender] token, then comparing the model's predictive performance against the unredacted baseline to check for output disparities.

Extracting named entities using an Indian legal Named Entity Recognition (NER) tool, substituting these names with a [REDACTED] token, and comparing the fine-tuned model's decisions to those from the unredacted dataset to identify potential unfairness based on identity.
